title: Windows MAX_PATH Git Checkout Failure
content: Cloning repositories with deep directory hierarchies or git patches fails on Windows with Filename too long. Fix by running git config core.longpaths true.

title: Windows PowerShell UTF-8 BOM SyntaxError in Node.js
content: Writing UTF-8 scripts with [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 prepends a 3-byte Byte Order Mark (0xEF 0xBB 0xBF). Node.js fails with SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token. Use UTF8 without BOM (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false).
